Original reference-driven Blender reconstruction of the single-seat Rocket, with authored cabin maps, reconstructed passenger-space vessel, underfloor components, optical lamps, telescopic/folding wing, independent wheel/fan/yoke pivots and nozzle metadata. Visual reference reconstruction, not factory CAD, certified engineering or exact Tesla flight physics. No third-party mesh or photo texture copied. User-requested full-size left mirror: original 180 x 95 mm spherical convex glass, 205 x 120 mm housing and revised mount (radius 0.65 m); deliberately enlarged for game usability, not factory dimensions or optical specifications. Central tablet car artwork is an offline antialiased Blender rendering of this exact authored Rocket in its stowed-wing presentation, replacing the generic polygon profile; geometry and other image assets are unchanged. Reproducible source: scripts/render_tablet_rocket.py and art/textures/roadster-tablet-rocket.png.
Eight original Blender Cycles volumetric vapor renders packed as a transparent RGBA atlas by scripts/pack_smoke_atlas.py; no third-party smoke bitmap copied.
